events.label: Наука
entries: 2011 – The Mars Science Laboratory launches to Mars with the Curiosity Rover.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1922 – The Toll of the Sea debuts as the first general release film to use two-tone Technicolor. (The Gulf Between was the first film to do so, but it was not widely distributed.)
1942 – Casablanca, the movie starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premieres in New York City.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1924 – The Mongolian People's Republic is officially established after a new constitution, passed by the first State Great Khural, abolishes the monarchy.
2004 – Ruzhou School massacre: A man stabs and kills eight people and seriously wounds another four in a school dormitory in Ruzhou, China.
